$comment: THE ONE CONTRACT for the two rules added by beads sparkle-imfgv5 and sparkle-7m0f2x, parsed by
BOTH language halves' test suites so they fail TOGETHER or not at all.
WHY A SHARED FILE RATHER THAN TWO TABLES. scripts/lib/pipeline-health.sh and
apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/pipeline_health.rs are documented mirrors, and this repo has been
burned twice by them drifting: sparkle-vlnf7c (a shell `grep -q 'ok'` substring test greened
`BROKEN` while the Rust twin was already correct) and sparkle-negds0 (a pinning test covered the
classifier THRESHOLDS but not the READ that feeds them). AGENTS.md's remedy for exactly this
shape is 'share ONE fixture both suites parse, so they fail together' — the pattern
false-absence-corpus.json already uses. This is that fixture.
The cases below are driven through the REAL entry points on both sides: the Rust tests call
`probe_outcome::hysteresis_step` / `pipeline_health::contradiction`, and the shell test calls
`ph_hysteresis_step` / `ph_contradiction` from scripts/lib/pipeline-health.sh. Neither side may
re-encode a case inline; a case added here must be picked up by both.
sparkle-imfgv5 — a TRANSIENT, SELF-HEALING dip must not become a standing P1.
MEASURED: one pipeline-health bead accumulated 159 recurrence comments and was dispatched to a
top-priority agent as a fleet-blocking emergency while CI had been reaching green conclusions
throughout. The scan filed on the FIRST non-green reading and consulted no prior-pass state at
all, so a runner pool mid-replacement (MIG isStable=False, size 4/6) — a condition that heals
itself in minutes — was indistinguishable from a dead pool.
The policy has four knobs and each one closes a different half of that:
passes         CONFIRM-TWICE. A single non-green reading is a blip until a SECOND consecutive
pass agrees. This is the knob the bead is about.
minSecs        the sustained-window alternative, for a caller whose passes are irregular. 0
DISABLES it (never 'always true' — a 0 threshold that compared >= would file
on the first reading, which is the defect).
cooldownSecs   the RECURRENCE cap the bead's second sentence asks for. Once filed, a still-red
component is re-enriched at most this often, so an hourly scan cannot write 24
comments a day onto one card.
maxRecurrences a hard ceiling per unhealthy streak, so even a cooldown cannot accumulate
unboundedly. 0 disables it.
RECURRENCE NEVER WRITES PRIORITY. AGENTS.md records that explicitly (the ladder was retired by
sparkle-mzgqt); this policy governs WHETHER the store is touched, never at what priority.

actions.none: green, and no streak was running — nothing to say and nothing to write
actions.clear: green after a streak — the streak, the filing count and the cooldown all RESET, so a later dip must re-confirm from scratch
actions.hold: non-green but UNCONFIRMED — the reading is still reported, the store is not touched
actions.file: non-green and confirmed — create or enrich exactly one bead now
actions.suppress: non-green and confirmed, but inside the cooldown or at the recurrence ceiling — the store is not touched

cases.why: THE case sparkle-imfgv5 is about: one unhealthy pass, then green. Nothing may be filed and nothing may escalate.
N consecutive unhealthy passes file ONCE, not N times — the third pass is inside the cooldown.
A sustained outage files, then recovery CLEARS — and the next single dip is a blip again, not an instant re-file.
A component that stays red past the cooldown IS enriched again — the cap must not mute a real standing outage forever.
The measured shape: red/green/red/green. Alternating passes never reach two in a row, so the store is never touched at all.
A healthy component with no history writes nothing and says nothing — the scan must not narrate every green pass.
minSecs is the alternative trigger for an irregular cadence: one long-running observation confirms on TIME rather than on pass count. Only reachable when minSecs > 0.
159 comments on one bead is the measured harm. With maxRecurrences=2 and no cooldown, the third confirmed pass stops writing.
passes=1 reproduces the pre-hysteresis behaviour exactly, which is what the scan's pre-existing filing-mechanics tests pin.

$comment: sparkle-7m0f2x — a component read GREEN while a probe ONE LAYER DOWN held the contradicting
number, and there was no cheap way to see the disagreement: the scan printed a verdict per
component and never the READINGS behind it, so confirming a suspect green meant re-deriving
every probe by hand. That is why sparkle-imfgv5 went unchallenged for 159 passes.
The rule is a RANK COMPARISON, not a second ladder: every sub-probe already returns a verdict
token, and the component's fold picks one state. When the WORST sub-verdict outranks the state
published above it, the fold LOST a disagreement and the scan must say so loudly.
IT MUST NOT RE-LITIGATE A DELIBERATE THRESHOLD. Each sub-verdict is computed with the SAME
thresholds the fold uses, so a state the ladder deliberately tolerates (a fully-busy CI pool
with a drained queue, sparkle-ot4dxb; a stale reviewer with no open PRs) yields `ok` and cannot
fire this. What fires it is a rank the fold could not carry — measured today in exactly one
arm: roborev's enqueue reading is UNREADABLE (component -> unknown, rank 1) while the
completion probe one layer down reads FAILING (rank 2), so the panel shows amber 'could not
tell' over a measured majority-failure rate.

cases.why: The live one: an unreadable enqueue reading folds to `unknown` while the completion probe holds a majority-failure rate.
The tripwire this exists to be: any future ladder edit that greens a component whose intake probe says severed.
The measured CI false-RECOVERED shape (sparkle-1xg2f6), as a rank: green published over a backlog the queue probe saw.
`unknown` outranks `healthy`: a green published over a probe that could not look is still a lost disagreement.
The fold DID carry the disagreement — same rank, no contradiction. Without this the check would fire on every honest warning.
A blocking component already says the worst thing there is to say.
The ordinary green pass. This is the case that must stay silent, or the loud line becomes noise and gets ignored.
`not_taken` is NOT a reading — a caller that never asked must not be reported as a disagreement.
A component that is deliberately off has no verdict to contradict; the fold excludes it, and so does this.
